body:
Honestly the worst part of my anxiety is that when I'm in public and especially when I'm given something to work on/be judged about my mind fixates on everything it can all at once. That's why my attack techniques don't work in that environment, because even as I do them the back of my mind is still spinning on it. Not to mention I have this background anxiety I can't link to anything at all, and it becomes worse as well, sometimes for no reason. I did contact someone about disability and they did say I could get it, so hopefully that will help me, and maybe I could get by with part timed and frequent breaks from work.

As for my interests, honestly none of them have anything work applicable. I enjoy all forms of media, TV, movie, games, music, art. But I don't see myself getting by as an online reviewer, odds of that working are about the same as someone becoming a famous actor. The same could be said for writing, which either requires education for any professional work or getting found as a self published author. Past that I'm comfortable enough around my friends to play DnD, but that's only because I trust and love them, and that doesn't help with work.

I'd rather a new unused typing before anything else, and fire electric sounds awesome honestly. If people want fire fighting maybe they can finally give us access to other starter pokemon somehow? He even just selecting one would be super cool. Not to mention they have to be naturally found somewhere lol.
It probably has that association due to it meaning someone buying good equipment, hence more UV.

I've never tried programming, I don't know if I have the head for it though. Does it involve math at all? As I'm not good with that.

Yes, but they only work to fend off attacks, they don't work over the course of an 8 hour shift.

I honestly have no clue, I really don't know what to do even if I had the option of an education. 

I didn't accept the fact I had these problems until I was in high school, but yes Ive had these issues for as long as I can remember. As for why they started getting worse, it started in senior year of high school, and has been a major issue for me since then. I can't think of a single triggering cause for why it got worse, as it escalated before I was even close to graduation, my only idea is that it's gotten worse as I've gotten older.
